Companion Animal Travel Desk Handling Notes

This section covers the recordkeeping and customer handling steps for animal travel requests at Aurelia Skyways, with a steady focus on clear checks and calm service. Staff should collect the basic travel details, confirm that the animal fits the carrier rules, and note any special handling needs in the booking record before the trip is accepted. When a passenger seems worried, the desk should listen carefully, answer in plain words, and avoid rushed language.

<<FACT F067>> Every request should be checked against the travel file, and any mismatch should be sent to the senior coordinator for review before the booking is closed. If a crate, bag, or other carrier looks unsafe, staff should refuse acceptance and explain the reason in a polite way. Paperwork must stay legible, complete, and easy for the boarding team to read, since loose notes create delays and confusion at the skyport.

If a traveler arrives with more than one animal, the desk should separate the records so each animal has its own handling note and contact trail. Staff should not promise special treatment that has not been approved, and they should not guess when the file is unclear. If the traveler needs follow-up, the desk should pass the issue to the duty supervisor and make sure the record shows what was said and done.

For any unresolved concern, contact the duty supervisor or the Companion Animal Travel Desk lead for review and next steps.
